meta.name: api-contract-generator
meta.description: Generate comprehensive OpenAPI 3.0+ specifications from FSDs and ERDs. Use when the user needs a contract-first API design, Swagger documentation, or interface definitions for frontend/backend alignment. Triggers on requests like "create API contract", "generate OpenAPI spec", "design the API", or "Swagger definition".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把需求文档和实体关系图自动转成标准OpenAPI接口契约
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做契约优先的接口设计,需要从文档和ER图生成OpenAPI规范
copy.tagline_en: Turn requirement docs and entity diagrams into standard OpenAPI contracts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are doing contract-first API design and need OpenAPI specs from FSDs and ERDs

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取你给的 FSD/ERD,生成 OpenAPI 3.0+ 的 YAML 接口契约;没有文档时,它先提问收集范围、认证等需求,再生成并与你确认。
howto.when: 当你说“创建 API 契约”“生成 OpenAPI 规范”等,或需要契约优先 API 设计时触发。

say.text: 根据这份 FSD 和 ERD 生成 OpenAPI 契约
say.note: Claude 会读取文档并输出 YAML 规范

say.text: 创建 API 契约,包含用户和产品的所有操作
say.note: 提取资源和操作,生成契约

say.text: 为这个接口生成 Swagger 定义,加 Bearer 认证
say.note: 会按需求配置安全方案

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads your FSD/ERD and generates an OpenAPI 3.0+ YAML contract; without docs, it asks about scope/auth/etc., then generates and confirms.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like create API contract or generate OpenAPI spec, or when you need contract-first API design.

say_en.text: Generate an OpenAPI contract from this FSD and ERD.
Create an API contract with all CRUD operations for Users and Products.
Generate a Swagger definition for this interface with Bearer auth.
